an7.49:1.1: sattimā bhikkhave saññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānā.
an7.49:1.3: asubhasaññā maraṇasaññā āhāre paṭikkūlasaññā sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā aniccasaññā anicce dukkhasaññā dukkhe anattasaññā

an7.49:2.3: asubhasaññāparicitena bhikkhave bhikkhuno cetasā bahulaṃ viharato methunadhammasamāpattiyā cittaṃ paṭilīyati paṭikujjati paṭivattati na sampasārīyati upekkhā vā pāṭikkūlyatā vā saṇṭhāti
